title: Godfrey Hirsch and Bob Coquille replacing Netto
summary: Netto recalls young Godfrey Hirsch sitting in on drums and later playing with the Tulaneans; Bob Coquille took Netto's place with Hirt.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. Godfrey was about 76, 77. About five years. He was 15, 16 years old. He was going to school. He went to Tulane, but how long? I don't know.
Well, he played in the Tulaneans until he was 80 years, until he was 70 years old.
Oh, who took your place with Hurt? Bob Coquille. Well, Bob, I interviewed Bob a couple of times. He had a wonderful memory for Tate, so we could check.
Well, my God, he could beat me. Well, Bob's dead now, isn't he?
Yeah. Yeah, but we have it on tape.
Yeah. So, at least I hope. He took my place there. He cut a couple of records with him, too. I believe Jumbo's still losing for him.
